universal_regulation_reference.universal_scope_note: An explicitly universal CTR row is distinct from the still-pending named finished-article route. Whether a marketed category is legally food, plus sampling and analytical method, must be checked. No laboratory PASS or automatic assignment.

source_rows.article: Chicory-dried or roasted, coffee beans, flavourings/pectin liquid
Anhydrous dextrose and dextrose monohydrate, refined white sugar (sulphated ash not exceeding 0.03 percent)
All types of sugars, sugar syrup, invert sugar and direct consumption coloured sugars with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 percent
Edible molasses, caramel liquid, solid glucose and starch conversion products with a sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 per cent
Cereal grains, except buckwheat, canihua and quinoa
Cereal grains, except buckwheat, canihua and quinoa (excluding wheat and rice; and bran and germ)
Packaged drinking water (other than mineral water)
Packaged drinking water (other than mineral water)
Packaged drinking water (other than mineral water)
Milks (Concentration factor shall be applied to partially or wholly dehydrated milks)
source_rows.unit: mg/kg or mg/L as specified in CTR metal table

source_rows.article: Infant milk substitutes and Infant foods
Raw sugars except those sold for direct consumption or used for manufacturing purpose other than the manufacture of refined sugar

records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Dispensed water through a purification vending machine is not itself packaged drinking water.
records.positive_evidence_required: Obtain sale unit and dispenser specification; apply FSSR 2.10.9 and current IS 10500 separately.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Copper row names individual roasted/dried chicory and coffee beans, not the standardized formulated Coffee-Chicory Mixture.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm coffee/chicory proportions, standard 2.10.4 and exact finished CTR scope.

finished_standard_evidence.finished_identity_statement: Ground coffee-chicory powder is a blend of roasted ground coffee and roasted chicory, with at least 51% coffee by mass.
documented_requirements: Regular mixture: moisture not more than 5.0%
Regular mixture: total ash dry basis not more than 7.5%
Regular mixture: acid-insoluble ash dry basis not more than 0.6%
finished_standard_evidence.ctr_transfer_gate: Require exact standard subtype (regular, instant or decaffeinated), composition and marketed form. CTR copper row for dried/roasted chicory and coffee beans names ingredients rather than this finished blend.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Formulated supplements for children are legally separate from infant formula and infant-food rows.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm finished age/product category (children older than 24 to 36 months), not merely infant ingredients.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Frozen fruits are not preserved jams/jellies, and freezing does not prove another named fresh-fruit class.
records.positive_evidence_required: Identify fruit species, processed form, sampling and applicable commodity classification.

finished_standard_evidence.finished_identity_statement: Frozen fruit may be a single fruit or a prepared fruit product, and may include other permitted ingredients.
documented_requirements: Thermal centre reaches at least -18°C after thermal stabilisation
Fruit blanched to inactivate enzymes only if required
Appendix B microbiological provisions remain relevant
finished_standard_evidence.ctr_transfer_gate: Require declared fruit species, all ingredients, processing, marketed physical form and named article. Freezing does not make the marketed item a jam, fruit preserve, fruit pulp, canned fruit or automatically the named fresh-fruit metal article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Catechu edible extract is not necessarily sold as regulated food colour on dry colouring matter basis.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm specific catechu grade, use and whether marketed as food colour.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Fruit cheese is distinct from jam (fruit preserves) and jellies unless legal finished-form proof establishes the actual named article.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify FSSR 2.3.33 subtype and food physical identity.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Seedless tamarind is not fruit jam or jelly solely by having its seeds removed.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify dried/pulp/paste preparation and finished processed article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Coconut milk powder is non-dairy fruit-derived product, not animal milk undergoing concentration.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify coconut extraction, powder composition and legal article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Frozen vegetables do not become canned vegetables; 'other vegetables' article requires appropriate actual commodity scope.
records.positive_evidence_required: Identify species, processing, packaging and applicable whole/processed vegetable CTR row.

finished_standard_evidence.finished_identity_statement: Frozen vegetables are washed, blanched and frozen; flavouring or other permitted ingredients may also be present.
documented_requirements: Thermal centre reaches at least -18°C after thermal stabilisation
Appendix B microbiological provisions remain relevant
finished_standard_evidence.ctr_transfer_gate: Require marketed vegetable species and composition; do not automatically apply the specific canned-food tin or a raw-vegetable pesticide MRL to blanched/frozen composite produce.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Whole cocoa beans are not manufactured defatted cocoa powder.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm raw/roasted cocoa bean lot, cacao form and appropriate official article.

records.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Dry cocoa-and-sugar mixture is neither pure cocoa powder nor refined white sugar.
records.positive_evidence_required: Establish finished mixture composition and exact processed article; do not apply ingredient rows.

records.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Cocoa mass/liquor and press cake have distinct fat contents and identities; cocoa-powder fat-free analytical basis cannot transfer.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm whether marketed article is cocoa mass, fat-reduced powder or cake, and analytical basis.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Both exact cereal grain metal articles explicitly exclude quinoa.
records.positive_evidence_required: Keep these numeric routes rejected for quinoa despite FoSCoS cereals positioning.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Chia is not automatically cereal grain or pulse and the specific crop identity is unlisted in those rows.
records.positive_evidence_required: Obtain Salvia hispanica seed-specific official CTR classification.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Carob powder is from carob, not cocoa/Theobroma cacao.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm identity against FSSR 2.11.7; do not assign cocoa powder metals.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Processed arrowroot starch/flour is not equivalent to a whole root/tuber vegetable.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify fraction/process and applicable starch/processed carbohydrate article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Water chestnut flour is distinct from cassava/root/tuber raw commodity articles.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify exact FSSR 2.3.64 milled material and metal article scope.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Animal sausage casings are not vegetables or unspecified edible muscle/offal.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm anatomy, slaughter species and true casing product with separate veterinary matrix.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Raw egg veterinary-drug MRL may require residue concentration, recovery and specific processed egg matrix rules before using on dry egg powder.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm laying species, dehydration factor and explicit processed-egg residue basis.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Pickled/acidified finished eggs cannot automatically inherit an egg-as-laid veterinary tissue method/limit.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm egg source, processing and finished product sampling basis.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Lead 5 mg/kg starch conversion article explicitly requires sulphated ash >1%; dried glucose syrup FSSR 2.8.7 has maximum 1%.
records.positive_evidence_required: Retain documented ash condition: this candidate fails for compliant dried glucose syrup.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Edible lactose is isolated milk-derived sugar, not liquid/dehydrated dairy milk.
records.positive_evidence_required: Check exact lactose FSSR monograph and finished article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Cube sugar FSSR identity and total ash are not alone proof of refined-white-sugar sulphated ash analytical threshold.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm production route and actual sulphated ash before any listed sugar subgroup.

finished_standard_evidence.finished_identity_statement: Cubes/cuboids must be manufactured from refined crystallised sugar.
documented_requirements: Moisture not more than 0.25% by weight
Total ash not more than 0.03% by weight
finished_standard_evidence.ctr_transfer_gate: Lead refined-white-sugar CTR row also requires sulphated ash not exceeding 0.03%, measured by its own method. FSSR total ash <=0.03% is NOT proof of the sulphated-ash result. Verify unchanged refined-sugar legal identity after cube formation.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Misri cannot be assumed refined-white-sugar or a high-sulphated-ash coloured sugar.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm actual misri process and sulphated ash measurement.

finished_standard_evidence.finished_identity_statement: The candy may originate from ANY sugar type or palmyrah juice; its name does not prove the refined-white-sugar CTR article.
documented_requirements: Total ash not more than 0.4% by weight
Total sugar expressed as sucrose at least 98.0% by weight
finished_standard_evidence.ctr_transfer_gate: Require original sugar/juice identity, processing, and independently measured sulphated ash. Do not convert total ash <=0.4% to either the <=0.03% refined-sugar or >1% high-sulphated-ash CTR lead bracket.

records.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
records.negative_finished_article_rule: The polyols generic category contains many identities; sorbitol-specific lead limit only applies to verified sorbitol.
records.positive_evidence_required: Obtain exact INS/CAS and FSSR monograph.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Salt substitutes have different compositions from sodium chloride food grade salt.
records.positive_evidence_required: Obtain specific potassium/sodium blend and applicable standard.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Colouring foods can be concentrated food ingredients rather than regulated food colouring matter.
records.positive_evidence_required: Obtain extract/concentrate classification, active colour and dry-colour basis.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Trehalose is not sucrose/refined white sugar; the cited subtype ash clauses do not establish trehalose applicability.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm legal trehalose article and actual product grade.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Sajji Khar may be an alkaline mixture and is not proven pure sodium hydroxide.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify source, constituent identity, and current monograph.

records.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.negative_finished_article_rule: A catch-all additive class cannot inherit a named colour row without identifying the individual INS substance.
records.positive_evidence_required: Identify exact approved additive and specific permitted-use/purity article.

records.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Nutraceutical VA–VF additives are not uniformly colouring agents.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm named schedule substance, formula and legal category.

records.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Enzymes and enzyme preparations have different sources, carriers and activities; no product-wide contaminant row is established.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm enzyme EC name, production organism, finished carrier, processing aid versus ingredient.

records.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Nutraceutical Schedule IV/VI/VIII ingredients are chemically heterogeneous.
records.positive_evidence_required: Identify exact listed ingredient and finished marketed chemical form.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Functional premixes have varied composition; individual ingredient limits do not automatically become finished premix limits.
records.positive_evidence_required: Obtain full formula and exact finished-product category.

records.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
records.negative_finished_article_rule: Colostrum products differ from ordinary animal milk and can contain concentrates and supplements.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm mammalian source, degree of concentration and official exact product article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Royal jelly is not honey, beeswax or ordinary sugar syrup.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm original secretion, processing and standalone current article.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Edible silver leaf is a food decorative metal, not food colouring matter.
records.positive_evidence_required: Confirm purity, foil thickness and FSSR 2.11.4, separate from colour-metal articles.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Narikela Ksheerika is a mixed coconut and milk Ayurveda Aahara preparation, not straight milk.
records.positive_evidence_required: Authenticate Compendium recipe and full product composition.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Ksheerapaka may include milk but the Ayurvedic mixed preparation is not itself fluid dairy milk.
records.positive_evidence_required: Authenticate recipe, ingredients, concentration and Schedule D contaminants.

records.negative_finished_article_rule: Soluble-fibre dextrin is a specifically processed dietary fibre, not any starch conversion product with sulphated ash >1%.
records.positive_evidence_required: Verify process and analytical sulphated ash before named starch-subtype consideration.
